name: newsportbook
description: AI-native court booking — agentic RAG support assistant (pgvector hybrid retrieval + RRF), concurrency-safe booking. Next.js 15. Live demo.

paragraphs: Book sports courts by the hour, pay securely, and manage venues — with an AI assistant that can actually act on your bookings, not just chat.
🌐 Live demo: Try it: on the login page, click Demo Player or Demo Owner — one click, no signup. (Or use demo-player@sportbook.app / demo-owner@sportbook.app, password Demo@1234.)
features: Agentic RAG assistant — the model chooses when to retrieve; hybrid pgvector + full-text search fused with RRF, answers cited to a specific doc and heading, and citations verified server-side against what was actually…

It books, not just chats — authenticated tools (searchvenues, getavailability, createbookingdraft, confirmbooking, getmybookings, …) let the assistant reserve a court and hand back a Stripe checkout link, reusing the…
Correct, tested payments & refunds — Stripe Checkout with duration-based pricing, idempotent webhooks, and refund reconciliation verified end-to-end in test mode.
Concurrency-safe bookings — a SELECT … FOR UPDATE row lock plus strict-interval overlap checks prevent double-booking under race conditions.
Real auth & multi-tenant isolation — NextAuth (JWT) with OTP email verification, role-based access (player/owner/admin), and a shared ownership layer so owners can only touch their own resources.
